title: exceptionWait passes a negative user-function value to Thread.sleep; IllegalArgumentException escapes Retryer.call after one attempt
cause: ExceptionWaitStrategy.computeSleepTime (WaitStrategies.java:386-394) returns function.apply(cause) without clamping it to >= 0, unlike the other built-ins that compute a per-attempt value (incrementing/exponential/Fibonacci clamp to 0). CompositeWaitStrategy (join) sums components unclamped, and Retryer.call (Retryer.java:176-182) passes the value unvalidated to the default ThreadSleepStrategy (BlockStrategies.java:46), catching only InterruptedException.
trigger: exceptionWait(E.class, e -> e.retryAtMillis - System.currentTimeMillis()) with retryIfExceptionOfType(E) and stopAfterAttempt(5); the first attempt fails with a server-supplied retry time that has already passed on the client clock (clock skew, latency, 1-second HTTP-date resolution), e.g. 250 ms in the past or a Retry-After HTTP-date from a server whose clock is 2 s behind.
consequence: Thread.sleep throws IllegalArgumentException('timeout value is negative'), which escapes Retryer.call after 1 of 5 permitted attempts. call() documents only ExecutionException and RetryException, so a README-style caller's handlers never run and its thread dies with the exception. A wrap()ped task's Future fails with IllegalArgumentException as the cause. Inside join(fixedWait(400 ms), exceptionWait) a -250 ms value cuts the wait to 150 ms, and a -600 ms value makes the total negative, which throws the same IllegalArgumentException.
premises: The Retryer uses the default block strategy BlockStrategies.threadSleepStrategy() (RetryerBuilder.build default), and JDK Thread.sleep(long) throws IllegalArgumentException for a negative argument (observed on JDK 21).

The exceptionWait function derives the sleep from a server-supplied absolute retry time (retryAt - now). No documented contract (exceptionWait Javadoc, Guava Function) restricts its sign, and it is negative once that time has passed.
Retryer.call catches only InterruptedException around blockStrategy.block and does not validate the computed sleep time.
Library built from guava-retrying v2.0.0 source (177b6c9) against Guava 22.0 and jsr305 2.0.2 with --release 8.
